shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/yagr@latest && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md | head -220'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json && printf '\\n--- version ---\\n' && node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json').version)\" && printf '\\n--- typings ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/typings -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type MinimalValidConfig|interface MinimalValidConfig|type YagrConfig|interface YagrConfig\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && rg -n \"update-in-range|setData|setSeries|destroy|dispose|theme|adaptivity|react\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore -g '*.d.ts' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/index.d.ts && printf '\\n--- dynamic ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.d.ts && printf '\\n--- types ---\\n' && sed -n '35,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"theme: 'light'|YagrTheme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/defaults.js | head -20 && rg -n \"export declare type YagrTheme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && sed -n '300,380p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/theme 2>/dev/null | head; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | rg 'theme|css' | head -30 && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.css"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "static UPlot|default.*width|constructor" node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.d.ts | head -30 && rg -n "getContext|new Yagr|dispose" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/index.js | head -20'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts && rg -n "export declare const useThemeValue|export declare const useThemeType" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/                        width: 1.5,/                        lineWidth: 1.5,/' src/CpuLoadChart.tsx && sed -i 's/                cursor: {showMarkers: false},/                cursor: {markersSize: 0},/' src/CpuLoadChart.tsx && npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'new uplot|new UPlot|uplot\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/index.js | head -10 && rg -n 'class UPlot|constructor\\(opts, data, targ' node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.iife.js | head"
/bin/bash -lc "head -40 node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.iife.js && rg -n 'function uPlot|const uPlot|class uPlot|var uPlot' node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.iife.js | head"
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -path '*docs*' | head -20 && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -name 'docs' -type d | head"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/var(--g-color-base-positive-hover)/var(--g-color-base-positive-heavy)/' src/CpuLoadChart.tsx && sed -i 's/borderRadius: 8,/borderRadius: \"var(--g-border-radius-m)\",/' src/CpuLoadChart.tsx && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/const initialData = useMemo(createInitialData, \\[\\]);/const initialData = useMemo(() => createInitialData(), []);/' src/CpuLoadChart.tsx && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/CpuLoadChart.tsx | tail -40 && git diff --check && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/border: '1px solid var(--g-color-line)',/border: '1px solid var(--g-color-line-generic)',/\" src/CpuLoadChart.tsx && npm run build"
